$Comment: Extends a jar-shipped ActionAsset additively via Target:{Action} (rather than SawmillProgression.json's Target:{Station}; Action targets accept Xp/Loot/Conversions/Steps/Anchors same as Station). RPG Stations' own jar ships a standalone, zero-progression fish layer (Actions/PrepFish.json, the 'prepfish' action referenced here, plus its Stations/CuttingBoard.json and Stations/CookingFire.json anchors); this file is the only thing that makes COOKING skill XP flow from it, additively, without owning or replacing PrepFish.json. Mirrors SawmillProgression.json's own Xp entry ({WOODCUTTING, PerCycle 8.0}) 1:1 in shape and magnitude, a modest per-cycle award with no double-count risk here: Cooking has no other Xp source anywhere, jar or pack, so this Xp array is the skill's entire progression path. The MMO bridge forwards Work.Xp asks verbatim (StationCycleCompletedEvent.xpAsks), so no MMO-side code change was needed; Smithing's feature-gate precedent applies unchanged (COOKING exists only with this pack installed, per its own CustomSkills/Cooking.json RequiresFeatures).
